rajaExecutionEvidence.label: Official gallery img2 — 'RAJA ENTERPRISES' branded equipment inside the hanger
rajaExecutionEvidence.provides: PROBABLE RAJA EXECUTION EVIDENCE — the strongest found so far. The photograph shows several high-level air-cooling units mounted under the clear-span hanger roof, each carrying a red asset number (bay 38 legible) alongside the name RAJA ENTERPRISES. Asset-numbering plus company name on plant is standard rental-contractor tagging. Retained locally at _reference/05-eima-agrimach-2024/.

rajaExecutionEvidence.label: Exhibitor list — the negative control
rajaExecutionEvidence.provides: CRITICAL CORROBORATION. 'Raja' appears nowhere among the 112 official exhibitors, so the branding in the photograph cannot be a stallholder's fascia. The same list independently matches other signage visible in the frame (ASPEE AGRO, BCS India, TeeJet), confirming the list and the photograph describe the same hall.
